docs.title: Welcome!
docs.text:
Gregtech Modern Extended Features, or GT:EF for short, an small addon for GTCEu Modern 1.20.1 (7.5.3) that contains a few QoL features for any GTM Playthrough, also contains a few utilites for Addon/Modpack developers

Quick mention that this project could also be great for people that's getting into GTM Addon development! since everything is pretty basic and follows most of the native/public APIs GT provides

Work in progress

Please note that this documentation is currently heavily work-in-progress and therefore still missing a lot of content.

docs.title: How to include it
docs.text:
Through gradle dependencies using Modrinth: 

repositories {

  exclusiveConcent {
    forRepository {
      maven {
        name = "Modrinth"
        url = "https://api.modrinth.com/maven"
      }
    }

    filter {
      includeGroup "maven.modrinth"
    }
  }

}

dependencies {
  modImplementation("maven.modrinth:extendedfeatures:${minecraft_version}-${gtef_version}")
}
Your gradle.properties: 
# Base properties
    minecraft_version = 1.20.1
# Dependencies
    gtef_version = 3.0.0-forge

Simple "mod import" using Curse Maven Snippets: 

// "1604172" = Project ID, "9064844" = Mod file, this one points to 3.0.0
dependencies {
    modCompileOnly("curse.maven:gtm-extended-features-1604172:9064844")
}

docs.title: Robust Alloy Materializer [RAM]
docs.text: A bigger Alloy Blast Smelter that has Perfect Overclocks and Batching capabilities, but only allows 1 energy hatch

docs.title: Large Cracking Machine [LCM]
docs.text: IV Version of the Cracker, may help with Oil-Based infrastructure

docs.title: Large Pyrolysis Oven [LPO]
docs.text: IV Version of the Pyro Oven, allows parallel hatches

docs.title: Synthesys Vessel [SyV]
docs.text:
My "vision" of what most players know as Chemical Plant.

As of now, only performs shortened recipes for the Platline and Naqline, in future updates it will get recipes for Polymers + other recipes that could have a shortened variant

docs.title: Expanded Assembly Line [EAL]
docs.text: An assembly line that allows Gregtech Stocking Hatchess (An AE2 Integration) for both Item and Fluid input, but is limited to Only One Energy Hatch and Wireless Optical Receptors

docs.title: Rock Processing Plant [RPP]
docs.text: Intended to simplify processing lines of Rocks combining a Macerator, an Electrolyzer and a Centrifuge all in one single multi (although it may need another structure rework for the centrifuge part lmao)

docs.title: Industrial Greenhouse [IG]
docs.text: What do i need to say here? it just allows an easier way to obtain wood

docs.title: Artificial Conservatory [AC]
docs.text: The previous, but IV :v

docs.title: Universal Dissasembly Machine [UDM]
docs.text: Indexes all crafting, assembler and assembly line recipes for machines/multiblock controllers, and allows the player to disassemble and get back all the components used to made it in the first place

docs.title: Matrix Data Relay [MDR]
docs.text:
Wireless data bank, needs 144mb/t of PCB Coolant while working.

Each part it allows drains a different EU value:

  • The LuV Transmissor consumes 1A of ZPM Energy (131.072 EU/t)
  • The ZPM Transmissor consumes 1A of UV Energy (524.288 EU/t)
  • THe UV Transmissor consumes 1A of UHV Energy (2.097.152 EU/t)
  • Regular Data Hatches uses 1980 EU/t
  • Expanded Data Hatches uses 4096 EU/t

docs.title: Large Gas Collector [LGC]
docs.text: Multiblock version of the regular Singleblock Gas Collectors

docs.title: Power Transformer [PwT]
docs.text: Active transformer that can be expanded to 4 rows that allows any inputs or outputs

docs.title: Large Fisher [LF]
docs.text: Allows gathering large quantities of fish

docs.title: Configurable Cleaning Maintenance Hatch
docs.text: Combines a Configurable Maintenance Hatch with the Cleaning Maintenance Hatch, so you can run cleanroom recipes outside the cleanroom slightly faster

docs.title: Expanded Data Access Hatches
docs.text: Bigger data access hatches

docs.title: Wireless Optical Transmissors/Receptor Hatches
docs.text: Allows sharing research data to assembly lines without the need of Optical Fiber Pipes, isn't that great?

docs.title: Universal Circuits
docs.text: although there is multiple instances where you would say "Why there's universal circuits in this addon?", it's necessary for the Universal Dissasembly Machine, to return the player only 1 type of circuit when a recipe is runned

docs.title: MACHINE_PARALLEL
docs.text:
Allows parallels without a proper parallel hatch, has configurable duration and energy

// Java
import static com.extendedfeatures.gtef.modifiers.ExtendedModifiers.*;

.recipeModifiers(
    MACHINE_PARALLEL(
        8, // Max Parallels
        0.5, // Duration Multiplier
        0 // Energy Multiplier
    )
)

// KubeJS
const $ExtendedModifiers = Java.loadClass('com.extendedfeatures.gtef.modifiers.ExtendedModifiers');

.recipeModifiers(
    $ExtendedModifiers.MACHINE_PARALLEL(
        8, // Max Parallels
        0.5, // Duration Multiplier
        0 // Energy Multiplier
    )
)

docs.title: SCALING_PARALLEL
docs.text:
Parallels and duration increase every time a recipe cycle finishes, EUt is not modified The cycle count resets when the machine goes idle

// Java
import com.extendedfeatures.gtef.modifiers.ExtendedModifiers;

.recipeModifiers(
    ExtendedModifiers.SCALING_PARALLEL(
        1, // Base parallels
        64, // Max Parallels
        2, // Parallels per Cycle
        0.25 // Duration per Cycle
    )
)

// KubeJS
const $ExtendedModifiers = Java.loadClass('com.extendedfeatures.gtef.modifiers.ExtendedModifiers');

.recipeModifiers(
    $ExtendedModifiers.SCALING_PARALLEL(
        1, // Base parallels
        64, // Max Parallels
        2, // Parallels per Cycle
        0.25 // Duration per Cycle
    )
)

docs.title: Version 2.3.0
docs.text:
Robust Alloy Materializer:

  1. Stress Proof Casings has been replaced with Robust Tungstensteel Casings

  2. Added Batch Mode

  3. Energy hatches have been changed to be only 1 instead of 2, laser hatch remains the same

  4. Now has a proper shapeInfo to display that coils can be replaced with anothers, just as any gtceu multiblock that has regular coils

  5. Added recoveryItems condition, meaning, the muffler hatch will return tiny ashes

Advanced Cracking Unit:

  1. Name has been changed to "Large Cracking Machine"
  2. Tempered glass was replaced with laminated glass and clean stainless steel casings were replaced with robust tungstensteel casings to match an "IV Counterpart"

  1. Received a shapeinfo to reflect coil upgrades
  2. Added recoveryItems condition

Enlarged Reaction Chamber:

  1. Renamed to Synthesis Vessel
  2. Removed pointless parallel hatch condition (see change 4)
  3. Added batch mode
  4. Parallels lowered to 8 (before: 16)
  5. Added "Chemical Skips", this includes the Platline and Naqline, future updates will include Polymers and Fuels

Large Pyrolysis Unit:

  1. Renamed to "Large Pyrolysis Oven"

  2. All of its structure has been modified to match an "IV Counterpart"

  1. Received a shapeInfo to reflect upgradable coils

  2. Added recoveryItems condition

  3. Overlay modified due to having an undesired ULV Casing Background

Advanced Fusion Reactors:

Not quite relevant, they just got their shapeInfo to reflect its fusion glass variant

Compact Assembly Line:

  1. Parallels have been nerfed (8 -> 4)
  2. From 2.3.0 and beyond, only works using Wireless Optical Reception Hatches
  3. Shortened by 2 blocks

Rock Processing Facility:

  1. Renamed to "Rock Processing Plant"

  2. Added Batch mode

  3. Structure remains the same

Industrial Greenhouse & Tree Growing Chamber remains unnafected

Disassembler

Structure modified

Expanded Databank remains unnafected

docs.title: Internal Mod Changes
docs.text:
1. Configuration has been extended, now the addon has 3 different creative tabs for Multiblocks, Universal Circuits and Optical Machines

  2. With the previous change, a Mixin has been added to fix an issue with empty creative tabs leaving an empty gap when empty

docs.title: Main changes
docs.text:
AFRs (Advanced Fusion Reactors) and TIERED_PARALLEL (also with TIERED_TOOLTIP) were removed due to gameplay balance concerns.

Greenhouse recipe times were reduced: normal recipes now take 16 seconds, and boosted recipes take 12.5s.

New multiblock: Large Gas Collector [LGC].

A few changes were made in Synthesis Vessel structure adding heat vents and a shapeInfo to reflect (any)coils placement

New addition: Configurable Cleaning Maintenance Hatch — basically a configurable maintenance hatch for cleanroom recipes.

Cloud Transmission Database was renamed to Matrix Data Relay.

docs.title: Internal changes
docs.text:
Custom parallels: Previous versions required MACHINE_PARALLE.apply(int parallels), this version changed that to MACHINE_PARALLEL(int parallels)

MAX_CUSTOM_PARALLEL parameter removed — by default the max value an int can take is 2147483647 (just 2^31-1).

Wireless Optical Transmitters/Receivers have been renamed to Wireless Optical Transmissors/Receptors. Range display range renders have been completely changed from the particle display; it now has a Dynamic Render display based on the max distance of each transmissor.

  • ZPM and UV scan range have been modified:
Old range New Range ZPM Transmissor UV Transmissor 24 32 32 64
  • Removed "OPTICAL_TAB" in favor of putting most singleblock features inside a single creative tab.

docs.title: New: Power Transformer [PT]
docs.text:
An alternative active transformer that can be expanded up to 4 layers for more inputs, or rather, outputs — whatever you like the most.

All multiblocks were significantly changed for the sake of balance for GTCEu core gameplay aspects.

docs.title: 1. Robust Alloy Materializer
docs.text:
• Lost parallel hatches in exchange for Perfect Overclock and Batch Mode
  • Definitive removal of laser hatches usage — they are really broken for what an ABS multiblock can do
  • Changed controller overlay

docs.title: 2. Synthesis Vessel
docs.text:
• No longer performs LCR recipes; only performs its own recipe type
  • Lost machine parallels in exchange for Perfect Overclock and Batch Mode

docs.title: 3. Large Pyrolysis Oven & Large Cracking Machine
docs.text: • Changed controller textures

docs.title: 4. Compact Assembly Line
docs.text:
• Renamed to Expanded Assembly Line [EAL]
  • Lost machine parallels in exchange for Imperfect Subtick Parallels and Batch Mode
  • Entire structure has been reworked; now has layers for each input, implying that it needs a common setup for normal Assembly Lines automation (whether it is AE2 or anything else)
  • Only allows 1 energy hatch, 1 Wireless Optical Receptor, and 1 Maintenance Hatch
  • Its logic now allows recipes without ordered inputs, but they still need a new layer per new input (according to recipe size) (I hope that's clear enough?)

docs.title: 5. Rock Processing Factory
docs.text:
• Structure modified (again)
  • Allows parallel hatches and has Batch Mode

docs.title: 6. Industrial Greenhouse & Tree Growing Chamber
docs.text:
• (IG) Lost machine parallels in exchange for Perfect Overclock and Batch Mode
  • (TGC) Renamed to Artificial Conservatory [AC]

docs.title: 7. Disassembler
docs.text:
• Renamed to Universal Disassembly Machine [UDM]
  • Added a new recipe mode:
  • Component Disassembly → Recipes for decomposing expensive components like Fusion Reactor casings and Fusion Coils (at the moment I write this)
  • Structure has been entirely reworked

docs.title: 8. Large Gas Collector
docs.text:
• New controller recipe, inlines/fits with the majority of GTCEu IV multis recipes
  • Changed controller overlay
  • Structure has been changed to remove rotor requirement

docs.title: 9. Matrix Data Relay
docs.text:
• From now on, requires a constant supply of 144 mb/t of PCB Coolant while working
  • Jade Provider: now shows the tier of the respective wireless transmissor placed inside the structure
  • Expanded Data Hatches have an energy usage of 8196 EU/t (1A IV)
  • Each wireless receptor has an energy consumption of 1 full amp of the next tier:
  • LuV Transmissor → 1A ZPM
  • ZPM Transmissor → 1A UV
  • UV Transmissor → 1A UHV
  • Slightly different color on overlay
  • Internal logic fix: controller not switching back to "unformed" state when a part of the structure is removed

docs.title: 10. Expanded Data Bank
docs.text: • Removed

docs.title: 11. Abbreviations
docs.text: • Some abbreviations were changed to be less "wacky" (is this the right word?)

docs.title: 1. Wireless Optical Hatches (Transmissors only)
docs.text:
• They now have a small toggle for custom linking behavior, whether they can connect only to Data Hatches / Expanded Data Hatches inside an MDR multiblock, or any nearby DH / EDH inside its maximum range
  • The range display has been modified to reflect an "Abstract" style with irregular triangles and a small "white bar" that goes up and down inside the render
  • Now they have a custom UI (using Minecraft Screen, without LDLib/ModularUI) for management of their functions, such as showing the range display and linked hatches, plus a cooldown for any new re-scan (3s)
  • Transmissors & Receptor: new overlays made by tomoko3seven/sqvizers

docs.title: 2. Expanded Data Access Hatches & Configurable Cleaning Maintenance Hatch
docs.text: • Added their respective emissive overlays

docs.title: 1. Immersive Vehicles init issue
docs.text: Fixed a client init issue with Immersive Vehicles during mod loading (Issue #3 - GitHub).

docs.title: 2. Client-side crash with disabled features
docs.text:
Fixed a client side crash issue where, if the disassembler, universal circuits, or expanded data hatches were disabled, the game would crash with the following message, due to them not existing as "icons" for EF's creative tabs:

[Render thread/ERROR]: Caught exception during event RegisterEvent dispatch for modid extendedfeatures
java.lang.RuntimeException: Unexpected error while registering entry extendedfeatures:extendedfeatures_multiblocks to registry minecraft:creative_mode_tab

docs.title: 4. Removed laser multiblock classes
docs.text: CoilLaserMultiblock & WorkableLaserMultiblock classes were permanently removed due to them no longer working (and I'm lazy to fix it xd)

docs.title: Version 4.0.0
docs.text:
¡API Breaking update!

Some important files have been moved into different folders, signatures/functions/classes names changed. Make sure to check all changes if you ever used them somewhere in your code

docs.title: Large Fisher [LF]

docs.title: Dual Oversized Computation Array [DOCA]
docs.text:
A huge upgrade for the High Performance Computation Array

The best setup using GTCEu Base HPCA Components allows the following stats:

  1. 368 CWU/t
  2. Cooling Demand & Available: 92
  3. 368 mB PCB Coolant
  4. Bridging enabled

docs.title: Matrix Data Relay:

1. Added custom machine interface

  2. Added FADE IN & FADE OUT effects for range display with a 1s cooldown to avoid spam

  3. Final structure rework

docs.title: Multiparts
docs.text:
Wireless Optical Transmissors: Independent interface has been moved into the Matrix Data Relay controller, with this, they are now a multipart exclusive of the MDR

CCM Hatch: Fixed small crash for not having an IS_TAPED property + added its respective overlay when taped

docs.title: Items

docs.title: Miscellaneous Changes
docs.text:
1. Removed Jade integration
  2. Added integration with GTCEu Terminals for Part Upgrading with Wireless Optical T/R
  3. Fixed SyV tooltip saying it allows parallels when the structure does not allow them explictly
  4. Renamed Machines to MultiParts (these are not machines whatsoever)

docs.text: More of a personal note, most of the changelogs below 2.3.0 are really basic, incomplete or basically unfinished With enough time, eventually they will look a bit better, but until that moment, it stays like that.
